in_game_description: A statue with a familiar face. Everyone should have one of these figures.
mechanics_text: According to the Galaxy on Fire website, the figure has a string on its back that, when pulled, says quotes such as: 'Take me home if you need a cure for that sleeping problem of yours...', 'Did I ever tell you I was a cunning linguist?', 'Don't worry, I won't bite... unless you want me to.', 'I'd wrestle a Rhinocitroll just for you...'
Collectible figures are extremely rare items that can also be bought for a high price from vendors in Space Lounges that appear at random.
Collectible Figures can be extremely profitable. Their minimum price is 1$ (cheaper than space junk), and their maximum is 10,500$.
Sell these at Eanya or Loma as they can sell up to $10,000 or more.
The further south one goes on the map, the cheaper they are, and vice-versa.
Ni'mrrod sells these expensive figures for just 9$ because the Vossk do not like Keith Maxwell.
